headline: CSX Corporation (CSX) and Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings Inc. (KNX) Show the Freight Cycle Is Turning. Southwest Airlines Co. (LUV) Shows Fuel Costs Still Hurt Airlines.
summary: Three transportation companies reported earnings on the same day this week: railroad firm CSX Corporation (NASDAQ:CSX), trucking company Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings Inc. (NYSE:KNX), and Southwest Airlines Co. (NYSE:LUV). All three are dealing with the same problem: fuel costs that shot up after the Iran war began. headline: CSX (CSX) Stock Could Be 14% Overvalued Despite Raised Outlook
summary: CSX stock has delivered a 76.3% total return over the past five years, yet both the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiple checks currently point to the shares trading at a premium rather than at a clear discount. Over five years, CSX has returned 76.3%. This puts extra focus on whether today’s price still leaves much room for valuation upside.
